leaves.name: silverbergZarhinThm35
leaves.doc: Silverberg-Zarhin, Semistable reduction and torsion subgroups of abelian varieties, Ann. Inst. Fourier 45 (1995), 403-420, Theorem 3.5, p. 406 (Raynaud's criterion as diophantine_zq.tex L816 cites it; the manuscript's bibliography L11077): over any field with a discrete valuation, n >= 3 not divisible by the residue characteristic, the n-torsion defined over the field itself (the print allows an unramified extension), then semistable reduction in Silverberg-Zarhin's sense (section 3, p. 405): the identity component of the special fibre over the residue field of every Neron model is an extension of an abelian variety by a torus, not necessarily split (DictModels.RaynaudOr.IsSemistableResT). Replaces raynaudSemistableSHOr (SGA 7 IX 4.7, not in the manuscript's bibliography): its specialization to strictly henselian DVRs, left disjunct (SZRaynaud.raynaudSemistableSHOr_of_sz35). The step to the kernel's semistability (geometric fibre, split torus) is SZRaynaud.isSemistable_of_sz (Stacks 04KV, proved)
